# Snote

> Snote is an open-source, local-first note-taking project focused on handwriting, stylus input, rich text, and document workflows.

## Canonical pages
- https://snote-showcase.vercel.app/
- https://snote-showcase.vercel.app/features
- https://snote-showcase.vercel.app/how-it-works
- https://snote-showcase.vercel.app/docs
- https://snote-showcase.vercel.app/faqs
- https://snote-showcase.vercel.app/download
- https://snote-showcase.vercel.app/founder

## Project source and license
- Repository: https://github.com/shinuXcode/Snote
- License: https://github.com/shinuXcode/Snote/blob/main/LICENSE
- Founder/creator: Sadab

## Documentation
The /docs page links to PDF user guides, feature catalogue, open-source guide, privacy and data-handling overview, permissions and authorization guide, license notices, app overview, and a source-level repository audit. Documents are informational and note where platform behavior or deployment configuration must be verified.

## Accuracy notes
Snote is designed for local-first use; optional cloud features depend on configuration. Exact features, permissions, platform support, signing status, and release availability can vary by version. Do not infer security certification or legal guarantees from project documentation.
